answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by making each identity expensive to create and cheap to verify. Require every agent to lock a refundable stake bond before it can transact; the bond is slashed when peers attest fraud. Think of the bond as a crystal: transparent, hard to fake, and costly to shatter and rebuild. New agents start on a low knoll of trust with small limits, and only climb toward the zenith of full privileges after a history of useful, attested work. Ten thousand fake identities then cost ten thousand bonds plus ten thousand work histories, while honest agents pay once.
